# Skill: DevContainer Rebuild Assistant

This skill encapsulates the knowledge and steps required to perform a full rebuild of the
DevContainer environment for the `chatgpt-docker-puppeteer` project. It is intended for use by the
AI assistant (Copilot) to guide and automate the execution of the tasks described in the audit and
checklist.

## When to use this skill

- When a user requests an audit, plan, or execution of DevContainer rebuild or upgrades.
- When making changes to the `.devcontainer/Dockerfile`, `devcontainer.json`, or associated
  lifecycle scripts.
- When adding or updating CI workflows related to the container build.

## Knowledge encoded

- The repository uses Node.js 24+ and a sophisticated devcontainer setup with external Chrome proxy
  and health checks.
- Key scripts: `post-start.sh`, `post-attach.sh`, and auxiliary helpers in
  `scripts/devcontainer/common.sh` and `devcontainer/verify-remoteenv.sh`.
- The Dockerfile now installs development utilities (`shellcheck`, `hadolint`, `yq`, `net-tools`,
  `postgresql-client`, `sqlite3`) and optionally `zsh` controlled by a build ARG (`INSTALL_ZSH`).
- A nightly GitHub Actions workflow (`docker-rebuild.yml`) builds the image, lints it, and runs a
  healthcheck.
- A checklist (`DEVCONTAINER_CHECKLIST.md`) tracks tasks and execution status.

## Recommended procedure

1. Read and update the audit document (`DEVCONTAINER_AUDIT.md`) and checklist.
2. Modify the Dockerfile to implement required changes and add utilities.
3. Update lifecycle scripts, moving shared logic to `scripts/devcontainer/common.sh` and adding
   validation hooks.
4. Adjust documentation (`DOCUMENTAÇÃO/DEVCONTAINER.md` and related) to reflect changes and provide
   snippets.
5. Add or extend CI workflows to lint and build the container, including scheduled runs.
6. Use the checklist file to mark progress; the AI should update checks as tasks complete.

## Behavior

- Always target latest versions of packages (no pinning) unless a task specifically calls for
  version locking.
- When executing tasks, run shellcheck/hadolint to ensure script and Dockerfile quality.
- When implementing new features, update the checklist and audit accordingly.
- Coordinate with human developers for testing, PR creation, tagging, and rollout.

---

This file is automatically generated when performing DevContainer rebuild activities and should be
maintained alongside the audit/checklist documents. Use it to brief new assistants or to remember
steps when returning to this project later.
